title: Strieber helps fund the first scientific studies of the Shroud of Turin

tellings.quote: And um I never meet them. I mean I talked I you know in a fundraiser context but I never like become friends or anything with them. So, we contribute as much money as we could afford to it, a few thousand dollars and we follow it

plain: In 1978, the author Whitley Strieber says, he and his family helped pay for the first scientific studies of the Shroud of Turin, a linen cloth kept in Turin, Italy, that many believe carries the image of Jesus. Strieber tells it himself: they gave "a few thousand dollars" and followed the work, though he only met the scientists, named as Jackson and Jumper, at fundraisers and never became friends with them.
